paragraphs: R' Chananyah son of Iddo; Tosefta, end of Eduyot.[^1][^2]

notes.text: ד״ה ב׳ פ״יג-כב is read as II Chronicles chapter 13 verse 22, not chapters 13–22. Earlier machine פ׳וגחבב differs from supplied locator; no named edition is independently checked. The heading comma is presented as an English period.

The biblical prophet and Chananyah’s patronymic are separate attestations, without an admitted relationship between the two Iddo occurrences. סוף עדיות means end of Eduyot, without a supplied numbered unit. The body title remains R'.
